title: Isometric movement and starter village proof
player_outcome: A controllable founder can move through a readable isometric village test corner while the camera follows within bounds.
acceptance_criteria: StarterVillage contains an isometric-looking test map with ground, blocking props, roof/door markers, and a safe spawn.
Player movement resolves against simple world obstacles instead of walking through blocking tiles.
Camera follows the player while clamping to configured village bounds.
Sprite sorting is deterministic by vertical position so lower objects render in front of higher objects.
EditMode tests cover movement collision, camera clamping, and sorting-order calculation.
